indicator_rule: Indicators meet Gentry's test (predictive, diagnostic, unambiguous, collectable). Lists stay flat, not tiered by time (Grabo). Readouts count changed indicators per hypothesis; no weighted threat score.

indicators.text: Severe GPS error over the area on at least 5 of the last 7 days
indicators.rule: severe share > 20% in the cell group, k-of-n 5 of 7

indicators.text: Space-weather indices disturbed at the same hours
indicators.rule: Kp >= 5 within 3 hours of the observed degradation

indicators.text: Degradation reported by only one feeder or one aircraft type
indicators.rule: more than 80% of degraded reports from one receiver or one aircraft family

warning_problems.title: Persistent GNSS interference over the Gulf of Finland
warning_problems.issue_on_change: Issue a warning notice only when the watch condition changes; stay silent while unchanged (ICD 203 allows silence for recurring products).
warning_problems.deactivation: Return to normal after 14 days with the indicator absent and coverage above 50%.

emerging_concerns: Anomalies outside these warning problems go to the review queue. Promote one to a warning problem after it recurs on 3 separate weeks; demote after 60 quiet days.
